viewsWelcome.contents:
The Flauz Harness console selects, inspects and composes domain harnesses: drive the onboarding session (industry, company, work types, roles), propose the draft through the real onboarding kit, and inspect any harness's projected navigation model.
[Begin Onboarding Session](command:flauz.harness.beginSession)
Activating a harness stays routed through the DH-01 authority, never this console.
